name: fig05-cell-environment
description: Fig 5b — cell–environment coupling. Environmental processes (reaction–diffusion, production/degradation, mechanical stress) act on shared chemical and mechanical fields; the single cell senses those fields and acts back on them through uptake and traction, updating its own location, mass, and shape. This closes the minimal sense/act feedback loop. All DRAFT processes: unit-bearing ports + behavior contracts, no dynamics.
